verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own docs say Profiles save and reuse browser state (cookies, local storage, session storage and cache) across multiple sessions. That is exactly what lets a logged-in state carry over so later runs skip the login wall. Its cloud sessions are what agents and Playwright/Puppeteer connect to, so the capability applies to agent runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching a profile to agent tasks, details on profile creation and lifecycle management, independent or hands-on corroboration that persisted logins survive across runs.
